verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy are a fair question for a cloud data-warehouse service like BigQuery, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows API version identifiers or a published deprecation policy. The closest items are a launch-stage label (the Rust SDK 'now in Preview') and a recommendation to prefer the gRPC Storage Write API over the REST one; neither documents versioning or deprecation terms.
